metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from HARMAN technology, HARMAN Phoenix 200 technical information (Sep 2024), C-41; the sheet names no densitometry, taken as Status M. The curves were traced off the sheet's bitmap, each layer by its order at the dense end, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts. The sheet plots relative log exposure, and its ISO 200 was measured by the ISO method: the curves' ISO 5800 speed point (0.15 over D-min, green and slowest layer) is taken as sqrt(2) / 200 lux-seconds, and mid-grey goes where a meter set to EI 125 puts it, 0.963 decades above. The sheet plots relative sensitivity on a linear scale, each layer falling to zero at both ends: taken as plotted, with none beyond, and balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The film has no orange mask: its base is its fog and stain, the dyes in the amounts that read the curves' own D-min (R 0.50, G 0.91, B 0.50). No spectral adaptation window: agx fits one to each of its own stocks' sensitivities. Dye spectra, DIR coupler model from 'kodak_gold_200'.
